## Prevention remediation for incident 1c0d (plan-review lane)

Post-mortem: `9097-2741-6462-424c`. Evaluate whether the plan-review `project.portability` criterion (or a sibling) should flag a plan that introduces or relies on a fallback chain whose terminal arm may be uncredentialed/unreachable in the environments it runs.

### Rationale
The incident's config chain fails over to `anthropic:*` which is uncredentialed in these environments. A portability lens ("works across diverse environments") arguably should catch "your failover degrades to a provider that isn't available here."

### Open decision (BEHAVIOR CHANGE — escalate before implementing)
This alters plan-review gate behavior. Needs a go/no-go on whether provider/credential-reachability is in-scope for `project.portability` or warrants a distinct criterion, and whether it is realistically detectable from a plan (credential presence is an environment fact, not usually a plan fact). Risk: this may be a weaker guard than the CI/test oracle — assess whether it earns its place or should be declined in favor of the detection test. Do NOT implement until decided.

### Acceptance criteria (pending decision)
- [ ] Decision recorded: extend `project.portability`, add a new criterion, or decline (with reason).
- [ ] If approved: criterion detail authored + registered per docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md.
data.title: Prevention (plan-review): portability criterion should flag a fallback chain whose terminal arm is uncredentialed in target envs
